SELECT SEQ_SF_FAMILY_RELATION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SF_FAMILY_RELATION (RELATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, FAMILY_MEMBER_ID, RELATION_TYPE, STATUS) VALUES (#{relationId}, #{memberId}, #{familyMemberId}, #{relationType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT r.RELATION_ID, r.MEMBER_ID, r.FAMILY_MEMBER_ID, r.RELATION_TYPE, r.STATUS, r.CREATED_AT, m.NAME AS FAMILY_MEMBER_NAME, m.LOGIN_ID AS FAMILY_MEMBER_LOGIN_ID, m.PHONE AS FAMILY_MEMBER_PHONE, m.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS FAMILY_MEMBER_PROFILE_IMAGE_URL FROM SF_FAMILY_RELATION r JOIN SF_MEMBER m ON r.FAMILY_MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT r.RELATION_ID, r.MEMBER_ID, r.FAMILY_MEMBER_ID, r.RELATION_TYPE, r.STATUS, r.CREATED_AT, m.NAME AS FAMILY_MEMBER_NAME, m.LOGIN_ID AS FAMILY_MEMBER_LOGIN_ID, m.PHONE AS FAMILY_MEMBER_PHONE, m.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS FAMILY_MEMBER_PROFILE_IMAGE_URL FROM SF_FAMILY_RELATION r JOIN SF_MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.FAMILY_MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND r.STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT r.RELATION_ID, r.MEMBER_ID, r.FAMILY_MEMBER_ID, r.RELATION_TYPE, r.STATUS, r.CREATED_AT, m.NAME AS FAMILY_MEMBER_NAME, m.LOGIN_ID AS FAMILY_MEMBER_LOGIN_ID, m.PHONE AS FAMILY_MEMBER_PHONE, m.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS FAMILY_MEMBER_PROFILE_IMAGE_URL FROM SF_FAMILY_RELATION r JOIN SF_MEMBER m ON r.FAMILY_MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND r.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' UNION ALL SELECT r.RELATION_ID, r.FAMILY_MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, r.MEMBER_ID AS FAMILY_MEMBER_ID, r.RELATION_TYPE, r.STATUS, r.CREATED_AT, m.NAME AS FAMILY_MEMBER_NAME, m.LOGIN_ID AS FAMILY_MEMBER_LOGIN_ID, m.PHONE AS FAMILY_MEMBER_PHONE, m.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS FAMILY_MEMBER_PROFILE_IMAGE_URL FROM SF_FAMILY_RELATION r JOIN SF_MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.FAMILY_MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND r.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY FAMILY_MEMBER_NAME ASC
